name: architecture-navigation
purpose: Build and search a compact map of architectural sections, shadow filenames, functions, classes and keywords; read selected decisions only.
pre_prompt: Use index first. Search literal task keywords/function/class names, then read matching section IDs with the current source SHA256. All source inspection is read-only; no implementation bodies are included.
post_prompt: Select a few relevant section IDs and associated shadow files. Include their tokens in each todo context estimate. Unknown links are uncertainties. Architecture metadata is mechanical; decision prose remains authored.
